threat_event: Attacker uses the always-on vendor remote desktop agent at AQ-05 to take over an HMI and change a chemical feed setpoint
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist group targeting water OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor agent with a password only; shared HMI login; flat network (scenario gap 1)
existing_controls: Hardwired chemical feed limits; independent analyzer alarms; manual-operation drills
treatment_plan: Remove the agent; put AQ-05 behind the OT remote access gateway; named HMI accounts (POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: Systems with remote access outside the gateway; vendor sessions without approval

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts enterprise IT (CIS, billing, work management, email) and forces precautionary IT/OT disconnection in every region
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large IT estate (about 16,000 endpoints and 640 sites); OT depends on IT identity and historians for normal operation; acquisition gaps (R-003)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 to SYS-12; BP-03 and BP-05 to BP-11
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of IT endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; OT DMZ at every ROCC; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: EDR at AQ sites; IT/OT disconnect playbook tested in every region; annual enterprise ransomware exercise including the disclosure committee (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; time to isolate an OT DMZ in exercises; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Attacker moves from an acquired system's flat network over the site VPN into regional networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-04 to AQ-06 site VPNs land on the regional WAN; local accounts; no OT DMZ at those systems
existing_controls: Site VPN access lists; EDR at AQ-04 only
treatment_plan: Restrict VPNs to named hosts; SD-WAN migration and OT DMZ build at the three systems (POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: AQ sites on SD-WAN with an OT DMZ; AQ identities federated

threat_event: A malicious or unauthorized PLC logic change at GCR goes undetected because running logic is not compared with the approved version
threat_source: Insider, compromised integrator, or attacker with OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No automated logic comparison; 7 of 40 sampled changes lacked post-change verification (P07 CM-3)
existing_controls: PLC key switches in RUN; change tickets; OT monitoring alerts on program downloads
treatment_plan: Automated running-versus-approved logic comparison; mandatory post-change verification record (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: PLC changes without verification; logic comparison coverage

threat_event: A compromised integrator uses its legitimate gateway access or delivers a malicious project update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 integrators with remote access; 31 of about 140 OT vendor contracts lack security terms
affected_asset_or_process: GCR-WTSS and other regional SCADA systems
existing_controls: Gateway with MFA, approval, and recording for 17 integrators; project files checked into the OT repository
treatment_plan: Security terms at renewal; annual integrator attestation; hash verification of delivered project files (POAM-012)
key_risk_indicator: OT vendor contracts with security terms; integrator sessions reviewed

threat_event: Attacker signs in to an internet-reachable cellular telemetry gateway with default credentials and reaches a remote-site RTU
threat_source: Opportunistic attacker scanning for exposed devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 gateways with default web administration found in P07 testing
existing_controls: Private APN for most gateways; local level and pressure interlocks
treatment_plan: Credentials changed and web administration disabled on the 9 (2026-08-20); fleet-wide configuration audit (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: Internet-exposed OT devices found by quarterly scans

threat_event: A material OT incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality playbook has no OT or public health scenario
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook built for data breaches; no operations member on the committee; never exercised with an OT scenario
existing_controls: Disclosure committee; 8-K templates; outside securities counsel
treatment_plan: Add an OT and public health scenario; add the COO to the committee; tabletop 2026-11-12 (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Days since last disclosure committee exercise; playbook scenarios covered

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in an unsupported controller, HMI, or server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,150 controllers past vendor support; 38 servers and workstations on an unsupported OS (4 in the GCR-WTSS)
existing_controls: OT DMZ and zone firewalls; OT monitoring at 31 systems; application allowlisting on ROCC servers
treatment_plan: Replace GCR unsupported hosts (POAM-008); controller lifecycle program 2027-2030; documented exceptions with compensating controls
key_risk_indicator: Unsupported OT components; exceptions past expiry

threat_event: ERP review certifications for the remaining 24 smaller-category systems are missed, or made without current cyber findings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 24 ERPs due by 2026-12-26; 12 RRA cyber elements done with a checklist; AQ-05 and AQ-06 used former owners' approaches
existing_controls: Enterprise RRA and ERP program; certification calendar; template cyber annex
treatment_plan: ERP sprint with weekly status to the COO; cyber addenda for the 12 checklist systems and AQ-05 and AQ-06 (POAM-019)
owner: Vice President, Resilience and Emergency Management
key_risk_indicator: ERPs certified versus due; days to the next due date

threat_event: Ransomware or a wiper destroys a ROCC's SCADA servers and recovery takes longer than manual operation can be sustained
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GCR transfer to the backup control center took 3.5 hours against 2; rebuild at legacy systems depends on integrators
existing_controls: Offline PLC and HMI backups; backup control centers; manual-operation drills
treatment_plan: Automate the transfer runbook and retest (POAM-010); rebuild media for each ROCC
owner: Vice President, Gulf Coast Regional Operations
key_risk_indicator: Transfer drill time; age of rebuild media

threat_event: Late Tier 1 public notice after a cyber-caused treatment interruption

existing_controls: Enterprise public notice standard with a cyber trigger; offline contact exports; regional drills
treatment_plan: Move AQ-04 to AQ-06 to the enterprise SOP (POAM-021)

key_risk_indicator: Public notices issued within 24 hours; SOP coverage

threat_event: Spoofed or replayed commands on the legacy licensed radio start or stop a well pump

treatment_plan: Migrate the 14 sites to private LTE (POAM-011)

threat_event: An intruder persists in the OT networks of the 55 unmonitored covered systems

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT network monitoring; HMI events not centrally logged at those systems
existing_controls: Firewall logs to the SIEM; quarterly remote access reviews
treatment_plan: Extend passive OT monitoring by population served (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Share of population served under OT monitoring

threat_event: A state-sponsored actor pre-positions in ROCC networks to disrupt water service during a geopolitical crisis

threat_event: An unauthorized setpoint change at TP-C cannot be traced to a person because of shared panel HMI accounts

threat_event: The single chlorine gas supplier for Florida plants cannot deliver for more than two weeks
threat_source: Supplier disruption (including a cyberattack on the supplier)

existing_controls: About 14 days on site; WARN chemical sharing
treatment_plan: Contract the second supplier; quarterly inventory check

threat_event: Manipulation of chlorinator controls at an RMP plant causes a chlorine gas release

threat_event: An operator overfeeds or underfeeds a chemical during extended manual operation after SCADA is lost

existing_controls: Hardwired limits; twice-yearly manual drills; grab sampling
treatment_plan: Written manual-mode procedures for each chemical at AQ-04 to AQ-06 (POAM-001 milestone)

threat_event: Deliberate contamination through a storage tank hatch or hydrant

threat_event: An intruder tampers with equipment at a booster station whose door alarm does not report

threat_event: Business email compromise exposes RRA and ERP content and SCADA diagrams
